<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  // Always show all grid items
  document.querySelectorAll(".grid-item").forEach(item => {
    item.style.display = "block";
  });

  // Always show all static content sections
  document.querySelectorAll(".static-content").forEach(section => {
    section.style.display = "block";
  });

  // If any dataset content sections are hidden by inline style, show them too
  document.querySelectorAll("[id$='-content']").forEach(section => {
    section.style.display = "block";
  });
});
</script>
